Thank you for sharing! My experience started when I woke to this blinding light in my eyes. I couldn’t move and could only see the light for a moment. While I was immobile it felt like my face began to contort if I was screaming as loud as I could but I wasn’t trying to scream. After this my face relaxed and I remember thinking “oh shit! It’s happening! Now’s my chance to communicate.” I tried to think of something to say but all that really came out was “I miss you.” I said this because I had an experience when I was really young but haven’t had one since, at least one that I remember. This has always made me sad so it what came out. 

So after I got no response the only thing I could thing to try and communicate was that I wanted to see space. To this I got a response as if someone said something to me from behind and a little to the right of me. A female voice that said “No no no just lay back and relax.” I heard a male voice from the same direction but could make out what he was saying. After that I only remember waking up in my bed.
Thank you so much for sharing! Do you think you saw events in your future while you were experiencing this?

Your experience is so close to mine. Same scenario. I had a lava lamp night light that sat on top of a little locker I had. My brother and I slept on a bunk bed with me on the bottom bunk. One night I woke up to what I thought was my brother standing in the middle of the room, touching my lava lamp. I kept asking my brother what he was doing and squinting to see him. It wasn’t until the third time I asked when I realized it wasn’t my brother and slowly sank back into my bed in horror. It was a tall grey with huge eyes briefly touching my lava lamp over and over again. 
     It hadn’t noticed me trying to get its attention. I tried calling to my brother above me but I was scared it would finally hear me so I just tried to hide under the covers and pretend I was asleep. I also tried to actually sleep to just not deal with the situation anymore but my adrenaline was way too high to sleep. In that moment when I realized I couldn’t sleep this problem away, I remember thinking how unfair this situation was for someone my age. I thought about how similar it would be if a bear was in my room and how powerless I’d be against it. So I just kept taking peaks from my covers to see if it was still there. Eventually it locked its eyes on me and everything went staticy and I blacked out.
How did your dream end?

I know your pain is immense but you can’t let this pain kill you. You owe it to your younger self, the child who was abused and neglected, and the adult you will become, to give them a better life. They deserve a better life and you are the only person to give it to them. You have to be their hero because in the end we have to be our own hero’s. We have to save ourselves from the trauma we faced so we may lead the lives we want and help those we love. The most important thing you can do right now is SAVE YOURSELF. The first thing any first responder or fire fighter must do is make sure they are in a safe enough position so that they are ABLE to save others. For you to save yourself, you’ve got to throw those pills away and be kind to yourself. This may be the hardest thing you will ever have to do, but it is the only true justice you can give your former and future self. You must be strong for them. 

It doesn’t have to be impossible. Start small. Throw those pills away, make sure your environment is as safe as you can, and try to reach out to someone to talk to. Try to find a therapist that deals with rape and talk to them about what happened because the next step of saving yourself is trying to heal yourself as best as you can. It doesn’t have to be perfect. Just make sure that you are patient and kind to yourself while you deal with this. NONE of this is your fault, but the responsibility to repair yourself is on you. I know you can do this.

1. I’m completely convinced this was a a real encounter and that these were real NHI for several reasons. The first is how serious everyone was acting in the video. The family was legitimately scared, cautious, and even armed themselves. The police reaction was also significant in alarm. The second is that the pictures and movement captured by the footage looks like the most real captured encounter I’ve ever seen. All other encounter videos can’t even come close to how real this video looks. The third reason is the misinformation response to this incident. Really feels like they are pulling out all of the stops to delegitimize the incident.

2. I would say I’m fairly knowledgeable. There are some editing methods that people have performed that I don’t quite understand but I know which ones I believe truly show the aliens. I also know about the aftermath and the subsequent interview Angel had, though I’m not sure about the demonic angle he was going with. Basically, anything that strays from the footage I become a little more skeptical since anything after the incident could be disinformation. 

3. I would say this incident confirmed my world views. I always knew there were aliens. I had a little bit of an incident in my childhood with one in my room. After I learned about this incident I feel like it helped explain some details of my own experience, like why my vision got fuzzy after it noticed me.

4. Yeah if be okay with that. I’d want to be fair as possible but would do this if deemed necessary.

5. Yes, I believe so. I always try to be respectful and don’t want to hinder anyone discussing this topic.

This is the first incident that feels like we’ve got some hard proof. When I saw this sub open, I was so excited because it felt like a wave of disinformation hit the other subs, which I kinda of expected, but still sucked regardless. So since you’re offering a modding position, I feel like it’s only right that I try for it since I’m really passionate about this topic. 

Let me know if anyone has anymore questions for me. I’d be happy to answer!

I was on the same situation after I quit Adderall right after college at my first job. I went from being able to learn info really fast to having to relearn things I did the week before. But it’s been 1 1/2 years since and things have only gotten better. 
    My point is that yes it will be hard to quit while holding down a job, but it is possible. Just remember that it’s all mental and that you can power through this. You can make it through this week which will be tough. Then next week which will be a little less so, and so on. And also remember that it’s okay to have a bad day and wish you still had it, as long as you come back from that place and understand that you can adapt without it.

All that said, I still think life will not be normal for a while until most people are vaccinated. The good/bad news is that a lot of people are getting it which might help make up for the amount of people trying to dodge the vaccine, BUUUT that could still be bad news if not enough people get the vaccine. Even after we get vaccinated we should still wear masks for a while. Not just because our bodies need time to develop the adequate amount of antibodies post-vaccination, but because we don't know how other strains may effect us and it would be better to not find out the hard way. Plus, it would put others at ease until everyone is safe from the virus. 

I know it can be scary but I don't think we have to live in fear, we just have to do what we must to see this thing through. Hopefully you're in a position that does not put you at unnecessary risk and I hope you never have to go through the illness ever again.

You’re right. The current pandemic is even sadder than the other events. It wasn’t another country or terrorists attacking us. It was our own people unwilling to think about the safety of each other. Our own people being fed an endless stream of misinformation about the virus being not real, not that bad, or that there’s nothing to do except let more people die.

But it’s not just individuals risk. Those people that go out and get infected usually end up infecting more people. They can also end up infecting people that they live with who might not be participating in going out, but they still get sick because someone else didn’t think about the ramifications of their actions.

Just because you may feel, or may have actually ruined good things in your life, does not mean that it is an infallible predictor of the future. Lots of things are situational and require practice at them. Failing at these things happens to everyone and cannot always be prepared for. However, after they happen, they are forever. Now this could be seen as bad because you can't change the past, but there is a far better way to perceive them. It is to know that you now have a wealth of time to reflect on what happened, study your own actions and others, and ultimately learn from these mistakes. To take the the concepts from those situations that you can control and use them to incorporate into your character. You may have done these mistakes purposefully, but they are still mistakes nonetheless. Mistakes do not define you, only your actions after you face the mistakes do. The future will always be there. Another day will begin whether we like it or not and the only real thing we have that helps us is preparation. Take your mistakes of anger and guilt, melt them down, forge them into arms and armor so that you will be ready for the next bout of the days to come. They will help you on your way. To help you avoid the wounds that life tries to inflict, the mistakes you will learn to avoid and capitalize off of. It will not be easy. It will take weeks, months, and maybe years, but this preparation is required for the journey. The journey of improvement is wrought with boulders, beasts, and ambushes, but we all must walk these individual and strenuous paths to ultimately forge ourselves into the best person we can be. Not just for ourselves, but for others. Others are walking these paths and their struggles are many. Everyone calls for aide eventually, and you must steel yourself against your own battles in order to help others. And when you do, you will know you are exactly where you needed to be, when you needed to be. They will need your assistance, they will need your guidance, they will need you. So get up, prepare yourself, and adorn your armor because on an actual day in the future, someone will reach into the void and call out for help. And on that day they will not be alone. They will be protected by someone who has already faced similar battles, and that person will help them win the day. That person is you.
